summary: Frontend-only visual/UX test of redesigned CyberHealth site across all 5 pages (Home, Services, News, About, Contact). All routes render, navigation works, no console errors, logo visible on white nav, hero background image loads, animations/CTA/stats all present. Minor visual issue: several partner logos are low-contrast against the dark navy partners section.

issues: Partner logos (AWS, Bitdefender, Tenable, PECB, Cyber Ireland, Proofpoint) are low-contrast/barely visible on the dark navy background. Only Huntress and Microsoft show clearly. Consider white logo cards or lighter section background, or swap to color/dark versions of logos.
One row shows only 2 partner tiles (Proofpoint + one) causing an uneven grid on wide screens.
Typing animation heading gets clipped on right side ('Cybersecurity Servi|' visible in screenshot at 1920w) - text container may need max-width tweaks or the caret is causing overflow.

action_items: Improve visibility of partner logos on dark background (use logo tiles with lighter background or swap logo variants).
Verify hero typing-animation text does not clip on wide viewports (1920px+).
critical_code_review_comments: No data-testid attributes anywhere - testers had to rely on text content selectors. Add data-testid to nav links, CTA buttons, form fields, and service category toggles for maintainable e2e testing.
Partner logos are hotlinked from static.wixstatic.com (original site CDN). Consider self-hosting to avoid future breakage and improve load performance.
Contact form and newsletter subscribe are frontend-only alerts (MOCKED) - no backend persistence. Confirmed per problem statement but flagging for future backend integration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Site is a static React redesign. All 5 pages: /, /services, /news, /about, /contact render fine. Home page checkpoints (headings, badges, feature cards, CTAs, stats, approach items, service cards, partner logos with alt attributes, golden CTA, footer subscribe) all present. 0 console errors. Framer-motion animations trigger on scroll. Contact form and subscribe are frontend-only alerts (MOCKED). Only issue: partner logo visibility due to color contrast.
